svg.title: One fetcher spacing requests to the three hosts it owns
svg.desc: Timeline from 0 to 5 seconds. a.com is fetched every second, b.org every 2 seconds because its robots.txt asks for it, c.net answered 503 at 1.6 s and must wait 4 s. At t = 2 s the heap of next-allowed times holds a.com at 2.0 s, b.org at 2.3 s and c.net at 5.6 s, so a.com is fetched next.
svg.text: one fetcher, three hosts it owns: fetch only from a host that is due
its heap at t = 2 s, earliest first:
